text: You see Vree.
source_text: You see Vree.

text: 你看到弗蕾。
source_text: 你看到弗蕾。

text: I'm sorry, you're disrupting my meditation.  Please leave.
source_text: I'm sorry, you're disrupting my meditation.  Please leave.

text: 很抱歉，你打断了我的思考。请离开。
source_text: 很抱歉，你打断了我的思考。请离开。

text: I'm sorry.  I'll come back another time.
source_text: I'm sorry.  I'll come back another time.

text: 对不起。那我等一会再过来。
source_text: 对不起。那我等一会再过来。

text: I'll be back.
source_text: I'll be back.

text: 我会回来的。
source_text: 我会回来的。

text: How could I know your schedule?
source_text: How could I know your schedule?

text: 我怎么知道你什么时间有空？
source_text: 我怎么知道你什么时间有空？

text: Uhhh?.
source_text: Uhhh?.

text: 啊？
source_text: 啊？

text: Don't raise your voice to me.  Do I have to have one of#the Brothers teach you some manners.
source_text:
Don't raise your voice to me.  Do I have to have one of
#the Brothers teach you some manners.

text: 不要对我大喊大叫。要我找位兄弟来教你点礼貌吗。
source_text: 不要对我大喊大叫。要我找位兄弟来教你点礼貌吗。

text: Sorry.
source_text: Sorry.

text: 对不起。
source_text: 对不起。

text: Yeah, ok.  Whatever.
source_text: Yeah, ok.  Whatever.

text: 耶，好啊。随便你。
source_text: 耶，好啊。随便你。

text: Oh, I'm scared.
source_text: Oh, I'm scared.

text: 喔, 我好害怕。
source_text: 喔, 我好害怕。

text: Greetings. It's a fine day for learning. Can I help you?
source_text: Greetings. It's a fine day for learning. Can I help you?

text: 你好。今天是学习的好时候。我可以帮你吗？
source_text: 你好。今天是学习的好时候。我可以帮你吗？

text: I know you're the Master Scribe, but what does that mean?
source_text: I know you're the Master Scribe, but what does that mean?

text: 我知道你是首席研究员，可这称呼是什么意思？
source_text: 我知道你是首席研究员，可这称呼是什么意思？

text: I need some technical information.
source_text: I need some technical information.

text: 我需要一些技术知识。
source_text: 我需要一些技术知识。

text: Uhh . . .
source_text: Uhh . . .

text: I record the knowledge of our ancestors for future generations.
source_text: I record the knowledge of our ancestors for future generations.

text: 我为了未来的后人，记录从我们祖先流传下来的知识。
source_text: 我为了未来的后人，记录从我们祖先流传下来的知识。

text: Interesting.  That means you know stuff.
source_text: Interesting.  That means you know stuff.

text: 有意思，就是说你知道点儿东西。
source_text: 有意思，就是说你知道点儿东西。

text: Yes. I guess you could say I know, 'stuff.'
source_text: Yes. I guess you could say I know, 'stuff.'

text: 是啊。我想你可以说我知道点，“东西。”
source_text: 是啊。我想你可以说我知道点，“东西。”

text: What can I help you with?
source_text: What can I help you with?

text: 我可以帮你些什么？
source_text: 我可以帮你些什么？

text: Go ahead.
source_text: Go ahead.

text: 继续。
source_text: 继续。

text: I need a water-chip repaired. Can you help me?
source_text: I need a water-chip repaired. Can you help me?

text: 我需要一个修好的净水芯片。你能帮我吗？
source_text: 我需要一个修好的净水芯片。你能帮我吗？

text: I'd like to know more about the weapons we make here.
source_text: I'd like to know more about the weapons we make here.

text: 关于我们制造的武器，我想知道更多。
source_text: 关于我们制造的武器，我想知道更多。

text: I heard something about holo-discs, how can I read them?
source_text: I heard something about holo-discs, how can I read them?

text: 我听说过什么全息磁盘，我该怎么读取它们？
source_text: 我听说过什么全息磁盘，我该怎么读取它们？

text: How can I prevent radiation poisoning?
source_text: How can I prevent radiation poisoning?

text: 我要怎样防护辐射中毒？
source_text: 我要怎样防护辐射中毒？

text: What's causing all the mutations?
source_text: What's causing all the mutations?

text: 是什么引发了各种突变？
source_text: 是什么引发了各种突变？

text: Speak to the knights.  Ask them to show you one of#the latest laser pistols I designed.
source_text:
Speak to the knights.  Ask them to show you one of
#the latest laser pistols I designed.

text: 去找骑士们。让他们给你看看我最新设计的激光手枪。
source_text: 去找骑士们。让他们给你看看我最新设计的激光手枪。

text: Thanks!
source_text: Thanks!

text: 谢谢！
source_text: 谢谢！

text: I've got another question . . .
source_text: I've got another question . . .

text: 我还有其它的问题……
source_text: 我还有其它的问题……

text: You are not yet capable of properly using the sacred knowledge.
source_text: You are not yet capable of properly using the sacred knowledge.

text: 你现在还没有能力去完全运用这高深的知识。
source_text: 你现在还没有能力去完全运用这高深的知识。

text: Use your Pip-Boy 2000 to read the discs. Insert the disc into the#reader. If you have the proper computer skills, you should be able#to scan the data.
source_text:
Use your Pip-Boy 2000 to read the discs. Insert the disc into the
#reader. If you have the proper computer skills, you should be able
#to scan the data.

text: 用你的哔哔小子2000来读这些磁盘。把盘放到读取器里。如果你有足够的电脑技术，就可以扫描出数据。
source_text: 用你的哔哔小子2000来读这些磁盘。把盘放到读取器里。如果你有足够的电脑技术，就可以扫描出数据。

text: Where can I learn the computer skills?
source_text: Where can I learn the computer skills?

text: 我在哪可以学到电脑技术？
source_text: 我在哪可以学到电脑技术？

text: Thanks.
source_text: Thanks.

text: 谢谢。
source_text: 谢谢。

text: Can I ask another question?
source_text: Can I ask another question?

text: 我能问别的问题吗？
source_text: 我能问别的问题吗？

text: The Brotherhood has some automated courses that you can take.#Here, I'll show you.
source_text:
The Brotherhood has some automated courses that you can take.
#Here, I'll show you.

text: 兄弟会有一些自动化教程你可以去学习。来这边，我给你演示一下。
source_text: 兄弟会有一些自动化教程你可以去学习。来这边，我给你演示一下。

text: Use this terminal to learn the basics of computer operations.
source_text: Use this terminal to learn the basics of computer operations.

text: 用这个终端来学习基本的电脑操作。
source_text: 用这个终端来学习基本的电脑操作。

text: You're not very bright, are you?  You're wearing a holo disc#reader on your arm.
source_text:
You're not very bright, are you?  You're wearing a holo disc
#reader on your arm.

text: 你不太聪明是吗？你把全息磁盘读取器绑到胳膊上去了。
source_text: 你不太聪明是吗？你把全息磁盘读取器绑到胳膊上去了。

text: You would need some anti-radiation drugs. I have some. Take#these immediately if you think you are near radiation.
source_text:
You would need some anti-radiation drugs. I have some. Take
#these immediately if you think you are near radiation.

text: 你需要些抗辐射药。我这有一点。在你认为自己临近辐射的时候马上服用。
source_text: 你需要些抗辐射药。我这有一点。在你认为自己临近辐射的时候马上服用。

text: Thanks!
source_text: Thanks!

text: 谢谢你！
source_text: 谢谢你！

text: Can I ask you something else?
source_text: Can I ask you something else?

text: 我能问你些别的事情吗？
source_text: 我能问你些别的事情吗？

text: Don't drink the glowing water.
source_text: Don't drink the glowing water.

text: 不要喝发光的水。
source_text: 不要喝发光的水。

text: Between the nuclear and biogenetic weapons used in the War, it's#surprising we don't have more mutations. However, if we can hold#out, everything will be ok.
source_text:
Between the nuclear and biogenetic weapons used in the War, it's
#surprising we don't have more mutations. However, if we can hold
#out, everything will be ok.

text: 很奇怪的，在以前滥用核武器与生物武器的战争中，我们并没有这么多的变异。不管怎样，如果我们能够坚持下去，一切都会好的。
source_text: 很奇怪的，在以前滥用核武器与生物武器的战争中，我们并没有这么多的变异。不管怎样，如果我们能够坚持下去，一切都会好的。

text: Why do you say that?
source_text: Why do you say that?

text: 你为什么这么说？
source_text: 你为什么这么说？

text: You're right. We'll be fine.
source_text: You're right. We'll be fine.

text: 你是对的，我们会好起来的。
source_text: 你是对的，我们会好起来的。

text: I've got another question . . .
source_text: I've got another question . . .

text: 我还有其它的问题……
source_text: 我还有其它的问题……

text: All the mutants I've studied have been sterile - they can't breed with#another creature.  If we could clean up the mutation sources, we#should be able to simply outlive the mutants.
source_text:
All the mutants I've studied have been sterile - they can't breed with
#another creature.  If we could clean up the mutation sources, we
#should be able to simply outlive the mutants.

text: 我研究过的所有变种人都是不育的——他们不能像其他动物一样繁殖。如果我们能够清除变异的源头，我们就是从人种延续方面也能战胜他们。
source_text: 我研究过的所有变种人都是不育的——他们不能像其他动物一样繁殖。如果我们能够清除变异的源头，我们就是从人种延续方面也能战胜他们。

text: Sounds like a plan.
source_text: Sounds like a plan.

text: 听起来是个好主意。
source_text: 听起来是个好主意。

text: Interesting theory. Any proof?
source_text: Interesting theory. Any proof?

text: 有趣的理论，有什么证据？
source_text: 有趣的理论，有什么证据？

text: I've got another question . . .
source_text: I've got another question . . .

text: 我还有其它的问题……
source_text: 我还有其它的问题……

text: Here, take this holo-disc, it's got copies of my autopsies on mutant#corpses.  It clearly shows that no mutant could possibly reproduce successfully.
source_text:
Here, take this holo-disc, it's got copies of my autopsies on mutant
#corpses.  It clearly shows that no mutant could possibly reproduce successfully.

text: 给，拿着这张全息磁盘，上面有我解剖变种人尸体的资料副本。它清楚的说明了没有任何变种人可以成功的繁殖。
source_text: 给，拿着这张全息磁盘，上面有我解剖变种人尸体的资料副本。它清楚的说明了没有任何变种人可以成功的繁殖。

text: Thanks.
source_text: Thanks.

text: 谢谢。
source_text: 谢谢。

text: Can I ask something else?
source_text: Can I ask something else?

text: 我能问你些别的事情吗？
source_text: 我能问你些别的事情吗？

text: I don't think I should tell you anything.  Perhaps later, if you#prove yourself to the Brotherhood's cause.
source_text:
I don't think I should tell you anything.  Perhaps later, if you
#prove yourself to the Brotherhood's cause.

text: 我想我不会告诉你任何事。或许以后，在你为兄弟会的事业做出了贡献后再说。
source_text: 我想我不会告诉你任何事。或许以后，在你为兄弟会的事业做出了贡献后再说。

text: I'm quite certain you're in the wrong place. Please leave, I'm rather#busy.
source_text:
I'm quite certain you're in the wrong place. Please leave, I'm rather
#busy.

text: 我很确定你来错地方了。请离开，我非常忙。
source_text: 我很确定你来错地方了。请离开，我非常忙。

text: You will destroy the knowledge that can save the world!
source_text: You will destroy the knowledge that can save the world!

text: 你将毁灭掉能够拯救世界的知识！
source_text: 你将毁灭掉能够拯救世界的知识！

text: Yeah, starting with you.
source_text: Yeah, starting with you.

text: 耶，从你开始。
source_text: 耶，从你开始。

text: No. I'm stopping those who could bring about another nuclear war.
source_text: No. I'm stopping those who could bring about another nuclear war.

text: 不。我在阻止那些会引发另一场核战争的人。
source_text: 不。我在阻止那些会引发另一场核战争的人。

text: Never! The Brotherhood will see that it never happens again!
source_text: Never! The Brotherhood will see that it never happens again!

text: 决不！兄弟会绝不会眼看这个再次发生！
source_text: 决不！兄弟会绝不会眼看这个再次发生！

text: That's what they all say . . . except you. You'll be dead.
source_text: That's what they all say . . . except you. You'll be dead.

text: 他们都是这样说……不单单是你。你将会死。
source_text: 他们都是这样说……不单单是你。你将会死。

text: What can I help you with?
source_text: What can I help you with?

text: 我可以帮你些什么。
source_text: 我可以帮你些什么。

text: I've got some important news to tell you about Kedrick. He's a traitor.
source_text: I've got some important news to tell you about Kedrick. He's a traitor.

text: 我有一些重要的消息来告诉你。凯德里克，他是个叛徒。
source_text: 我有一些重要的消息来告诉你。凯德里克，他是个叛徒。

text: What you would do if there was corruption within the Brotherhood.
source_text: What you would do if there was corruption within the Brotherhood.

text: 如果兄弟会内出现腐败你将会怎么做。
source_text: 如果兄弟会内出现腐败你将会怎么做。

text: Nuhh. Nuh-uh-nuh!
source_text: Nuhh. Nuh-uh-nuh!

text: 啊。啊－啊－啊！
source_text: 啊。啊－啊－啊！

text: Very good. I really can tell the lessons have helped.
source_text: Very good. I really can tell the lessons have helped.

text: 很好。我可以说这些课程会很有帮助。
source_text: 很好。我可以说这些课程会很有帮助。

text: Kedrick? He's been a loyal member of the Brotherhood forever. I#doubt you would even know what that means.
source_text:
Kedrick? He's been a loyal member of the Brotherhood forever. I
#doubt you would even know what that means.

text: 凯德里克？他永远是兄弟会忠诚的一员。我怀疑你甚至不明白这意味着什么。
source_text: 凯德里克？他永远是兄弟会忠诚的一员。我怀疑你甚至不明白这意味着什么。

text: Yeah, I do. Kedrick is a traitor and planning to overthrow your#leaders.
source_text:
Yeah, I do. Kedrick is a traitor and planning to overthrow your
#leaders.

text: 耶，是的。凯德里克是个叛徒，而且计划推翻你们的领导者。
source_text: 耶，是的。凯德里克是个叛徒，而且计划推翻你们的领导者。

text: Maybe so.
source_text: Maybe so.

text: 可能是这样。
source_text: 可能是这样。

text: You're certain of this? Perhaps we should go talk to the High Elder.
source_text: You're certain of this? Perhaps we should go talk to the High Elder.

text: 你很确定？或许我们应该去向高级元老汇报。
source_text: 你很确定？或许我们应该去向高级元老汇报。

text: Do not bother me with innuendo. Bring proof to the High Elder, or#say nothing of this.
source_text:
Do not bother me with innuendo. Bring proof to the High Elder, or
#say nothing of this.

text: 不要传播谣言。要么向高级元老出示证据，要么什么都别说。
source_text: 不要传播谣言。要么向高级元老出示证据，要么什么都别说。

text: Do what must be done. Stamp out the heresy and remove those#responsible for the stain.
source_text:
Do what must be done. Stamp out the heresy and remove those
#responsible for the stain.

text: 此事由你便宜办理。消灭异心之人，根除污点之源。
source_text: 此事由你便宜办理。消灭异心之人，根除污点之源。

text: Even if it was a trusted member of the Brotherhood.
source_text: Even if it was a trusted member of the Brotherhood.

text: 即便他曾是兄弟会可以信赖的成员。
source_text: 即便他曾是兄弟会可以信赖的成员。

text: And who would do the removal?
source_text: And who would do the removal?

text: 那么谁来做清除工作？
source_text: 那么谁来做清除工作？

text: Even so.  But proof would have to be offered.
source_text: Even so.  But proof would have to be offered.

text: 虽然如此。但还是需要证据。
source_text: 虽然如此。但还是需要证据。

text: Kedrick is a traitor. He is planning on killing the Elders.
source_text: Kedrick is a traitor. He is planning on killing the Elders.

text: 凯德里克是个叛徒。他正在计划杀掉元老们。
source_text: 凯德里克是个叛徒。他正在计划杀掉元老们。

text: I'll get the proof.
source_text: I'll get the proof.

text: 我去找证据。
source_text: 我去找证据。

text: Then we must go to the High Elder. Bring your proof and we'll go#talk to him.
source_text:
Then we must go to the High Elder. Bring your proof and we'll go
#talk to him.

text: 然后我们必须去找高级元老。带着你的证据向他汇报。
source_text: 然后我们必须去找高级元老。带着你的证据向他汇报。

text: The High Elder and Rhombus, of course.
source_text: The High Elder and Rhombus, of course.

text: 当然是高级元老和隆伯斯。
source_text: 当然是高级元老和隆伯斯。

text: Did you hear about the missing Initiate? This is terrible!
source_text: Did you hear about the missing Initiate? This is terrible!

text: 你听说过关于失踪的新兵的事吗？太可怕了！
source_text: 你听说过关于失踪的新兵的事吗？太可怕了！

text: I agree.
source_text: I agree.

text: 我同意。
source_text: 我同意。

text: Nuh-huh.
source_text: Nuh-huh.

text: 啊-啊。
source_text: 啊-啊。

text: If you can help him, I would be most grateful.
source_text: If you can help him, I would be most grateful.

text: 如果你能帮助他，我将十分感激。
source_text: 如果你能帮助他，我将十分感激。

text: Good deeds should be rewarded. For helping the Initiate, please take#these.
source_text:
Good deeds should be rewarded. For helping the Initiate, please take
#these.

text: 好的行为应当受到奖励。你帮助了新兵，请收下这个。
source_text: 好的行为应当受到奖励。你帮助了新兵，请收下这个。

text: Oh, it's you. What do you want?
source_text: Oh, it's you. What do you want?

text: 喔，是你。你需要什么？
source_text: 喔，是你。你需要什么？

text: I came to apologize.
source_text: I came to apologize.

text: 我是来道歉的。
source_text: 我是来道歉的。

text: Sorry, wrong room.
source_text: Sorry, wrong room.

text: 对不起，走错房间了。
source_text: 对不起，走错房间了。

text: Thank you for your apology.
source_text: Thank you for your apology.

text: 谢谢你的道歉。
source_text: 谢谢你的道歉。

text: Good day.
source_text: Good day.

text: 日安。
source_text: 日安。

text: That sounds like a manufacturing problem. We handle theory and design#only. Have one of the knights help you out.
source_text:
That sounds like a manufacturing problem. We handle theory and design
#only. Have one of the knights help you out.

text: 这好象是制造上的问题。我们只负责理论和设计。去找位骑士来帮你解决。
source_text: 这好象是制造上的问题。我们只负责理论和设计。去找位骑士来帮你解决。

text: Thanks anyway.
source_text: Thanks anyway.

text: 还是谢谢你。
source_text: 还是谢谢你。

text: Can I ask something else?
source_text: Can I ask something else?

text: 我能问你些别的事情吗？
source_text: 我能问你些别的事情吗？

text: Please talk to one of the other scribes. I'm trying to finish up#reports for the other Elders.
source_text:
Please talk to one of the other scribes. I'm trying to finish up
#reports for the other Elders.

text: 请去和别的研究员谈话。我正忙着完成给其他元老们的报告。
source_text: 请去和别的研究员谈话。我正忙着完成给其他元老们的报告。

text: I don't know anything about that. But it sounds like something I#should research.
source_text:
I don't know anything about that. But it sounds like something I
#should research.

text: 我不知道任何关于这个的事。但我好象应该研究一下。
source_text: 我不知道任何关于这个的事。但我好象应该研究一下。

text: Sorry, not one of my specialties. Maybe one of the other Brothers#would know.
source_text:
Sorry, not one of my specialties. Maybe one of the other Brothers
#would know.

text: 抱歉，这不是我的专业。可能有其他的兄弟知道这个。
source_text: 抱歉，这不是我的专业。可能有其他的兄弟知道这个。

text: Guards! Guards!
source_text: Guards! Guards!

text: 卫兵！卫兵！
source_text: 卫兵！卫兵！

text: You've destroyed my room!
source_text: You've destroyed my room!

text: 你破坏了我的房间！
source_text: 你破坏了我的房间！

text: What do you think you're doing with my things?

text: 你拿我东西想干什么？
source_text: 你拿我东西想干什么？

text: Who? Wait, that name sounds a familiar. Perhaps he is a leader#of some of the mutants.
source_text:
Who? Wait, that name sounds a familiar. Perhaps he is a leader
#of some of the mutants.

text: 谁？等等，这个名字很熟悉。他可能是某些变种人的领袖。
source_text: 谁？等等，这个名字很熟悉。他可能是某些变种人的领袖。

text: I assume you're referring to the last nuclear war. The Brotherhood is doing#everything it can to restore that which was lost.
source_text:
I assume you're referring to the last nuclear war. The Brotherhood is doing
#everything it can to restore that which was lost.

text: 我想你指的是最后的核战。兄弟会正在做一切努力来使我们曾失去的得以恢复。
source_text: 我想你指的是最后的核战。兄弟会正在做一切努力来使我们曾失去的得以恢复。

text: They are high-density, laser-readable, manufactured-crystal storage devices.#Each one holds over 4,000 gigabytes of information.

They are high-density, laser-readable, manufactured-crystal storage devices.
#Each one holds over 4,000 gigabytes of information.

text: 它们是高密度，激光读取，人造水晶的存储装置。每个可以保存超过4000GB的信息。
source_text: 它们是高密度，激光读取，人造水晶的存储装置。每个可以保存超过4000GB的信息。

text: The only salvation this tortured planet and its people have.#Without us, humanity is sure to perish.
source_text:
The only salvation this tortured planet and its people have.
#Without us, humanity is sure to perish.

text: 拯救这个受折磨的行星和它上面的人类唯一办法。没有我们，人类必定灭亡。
source_text: 拯救这个受折磨的行星和它上面的人类唯一办法。没有我们，人类必定灭亡。

source_text: I don't know. Ask Manufacturing about it.

text: 我不知道。去制造处问问这个。
source_text: 我不知道。去制造处问问这个。

text: He makes sure the Brotherhood stays on the path of righteousness.
source_text: He makes sure the Brotherhood stays on the path of righteousness.

text: 他保证兄弟会前进在正义的道路之上。
source_text: 他保证兄弟会前进在正义的道路之上。

source_text: He enforces the High Elder's wishes. With force, if necessary.
